recipes.title: April Sustainable Profile — April Brewer
recipes.description: April Coffee Roasters' one standard filter recipe for their House line and organic beans: 13 g to 200 g at 94 °C in two pours, each a circle then a centre.

steps.instruction: 60 g circle pour, then 40 g centre pour
60 g circle pour, then 40 g centre pour

recipes.notes: April deliberately publish one recipe for the whole House Coffee line — "we aimed to create a standard, no matter the origin" — and extend it to their organic beans. Each pour may instead be poured as a single 100 g circle. Brew time is given as 2 to 3 minutes and target TDS as 1.25–1.35, both windows rather than points. April recommend resting these beans at least 14 days and note they can rest longer, being slightly more developed.
